name: Quanta Services
description: Quanta is a specialty contractor that builds and maintains the electric grid, pipelines and communications networks for its customers: it puts up transmission lines and substations, connects new generation (solar, wind, gas) and data centers, upgrades and repairs utility distribution networks, and lays pipelines and underground utilities. It does not own the assets; customers (utilities, power developers, pipeline owners and, increasingly, data center and industrial owners) pay it for labor, equipment and, on large projects, materials. Contracts are a mix of master service agreements (recurring repair and maintenance work at set rates), unit-price, fixed-price and cost-plus. Revenue grew 20 percent to $28.5B in 2025 and backlog reached $44.0B at year-end and $53.4B at June 30, 2026, driven by grid spending and data center power demand; the ten largest customers were 30 percent of 2025 revenue and the largest was 8 percent.

businessLines.name: Electric Power Infrastructure Solutions
businessLines.how: Utilities and power developers pay Quanta for labor, equipment and (on large fixed-price or EPC projects) materials, under master service agreements for ongoing maintenance and storm work, and project contracts (unit-price, fixed-price, cost-plus) for large builds; revenue is recognized as work is performed, and profit is contract price minus crew, equipment and material cost. Driven by utility capital budgets, interconnection of new load such as data centers, and project execution.
businessLines.description: Design, installation, upgrade and repair of electric transmission, distribution and substation networks, renewable and other power generation and grid connection, plus services for data center, manufacturing and communications customers; reported as the Electric segment.

operatingProfit.note: FY2024 $1,958.7M (10.3%). Share is of the two segments' sum of $2,758.5M, before $1,147.0M of corporate and non-allocated costs.

businessLines.name: Underground Utility and Infrastructure Solutions
businessLines.how: Pipeline owners, utilities and developers pay per unit installed (per foot of pipe, per bore) or fixed price per project, plus recurring maintenance under MSAs; profit is price minus crew and equipment cost. Driven by pipeline and gas-distribution spending and project timing.
businessLines.description: Pipeline and related infrastructure for natural gas, oil and water; horizontal drilling and other underground utility work; civil and site work; reported as the Underground and Infrastructure segment.
